title: SemWeaver: Refining LLM-Generated Static Vulnerability Checkers with Analyzer-Internal Evidence
abstract: arXiv:2610.34928v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent work shows that LLMs can synthesize static-analysis checkers from security patches, but a compilable checker is not necessarily a correct one. A patch reveals what changed, not why the change is safe, so generated checkers often match only the surface edit and miss the deeper semantic condition. Existing refinement loops feed back compilation errors and validation reports, yet these signals describe symptoms without explaining what the checker misunderstands about the code. We observe that the analysis framework itself already computes the information needed to close this gap. Control-flow graphs, symbolic values, memory regions and checker callbacks are available inside the analyzer but unused by current refinement strategies. SemWeaver is a plug-in refinement layer that extracts patch-relevant analyzer evidence and assembles it with source context and validation feedback into a structured, provenance-labelled bundle. translated_title: SemWeaver：利用分析器内部证据精炼大语言模型生成的静态漏洞检查器
translated_abstract: 最近的研究表明，大语言模型（LLM）能够从安全补丁中合成静态分析检查器，但一个可编译的检查器并不一定是正确的检查器。补丁只揭示了“改了什么”，而没有说明“为什么这样改是安全的”，因此生成的检查器往往只匹配表面的代码修改，而遗漏更深层的语义条件。现有的精炼迭代循环将编译错误和验证报告反馈给模型，然而这些信号只描述了症状，却无法解释检查器对代码的哪方面理解出现了偏差。我们观察到，分析框架本身其实已经计算出了弥合这一差距所需的信息：控制流图、符号值、内存区域和检查器回调等证据在分析器内部已经可用，只是目前的精炼策略尚未加以利用。SemWeaver 是一个插件式的精炼层，它提取与补丁相关的分析器证据，并将其与源代码上下文和验证反馈组装成结构化的、带有来源标注的信息包。一个迭代……
tldr: SemWeaver 提出了一个插件式精炼框架，通过提取静态分析器内部已有的证据（如控制流图、符号值、内存区域和检查器回调），并将其与源代码上下文和验证反馈组装成带来源标注的结构化信息，迭代修正 LLM 生成的静态漏洞检查器，使其从仅匹配补丁的表面修改提升为捕捉更深层的语义条件。
en_tdlr: SemWeaver is a plug-in refinement layer that extracts analyzer-internal evidence—such as control-flow graphs, symbolic values, memory regions, and checker callbacks—and weaves it with source context and validation feedback into provenance-labelled bundles to iteratively refine LLM-generated static vulnerability checkers beyond surface patch edits toward deeper semantic conditions.
